name: Easy Pressure Cooker Hawaiian Chicken with Bell Pepper, Pineapple & Onion over Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lemon into a 6-quart pressure cooker insert. Add ketchup, water, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, minced ginger, and pepper, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup ketchup
water
¼ cup brown sugar
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp minced garlic
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the pressure cooker with the sauce.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the pressure cooker.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion. Add to the pressure cooker.

Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper, then add to the pressure cooker and stir to combine. Lock lid and set to pressure cook on HIGH for 4 minutes. Once done, drape a clean towel over the vent, then manually release pressure.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: After opening the pressure cooker, set to sauté on HIGH. Place cornstarch and water in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the slurry. Add slurry to the pressure cooker and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thick and glossy, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, gently squeeze the rice pouches to separate the grains. Tear the top of the pouches open about 1-2 inches to vent. Microwave on high for 90 seconds. Let stand for 1 minute, then carefully pour out and fluff with a fork.
To serve, divide the rice, chicken, veggies, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
